blocks.text: SignalStore is another NgRx way to organise state using Angular signals. Methods can call patchState to update a small part.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

items: `patchState` updates selected values in an NgRx SignalStore. Read its signals by calling them.

blocks.text: The store exposes a count signal and an add method.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: SignalStore and classic action/reducer Store are different APIs. Choose a clear approach for a feature instead of mixing names blindly.
